verdict.rationale: Dover's own scheduling docs describe sending candidates a booking link so they pick a time, and say Dover can book interviews directly on the interviewer's calendar with full calendar permissions. The evidence does not show that booking links read live availability across a team's calendars, and timezone handling is never documented, so the depth of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of live multi-interviewer or team calendar availability behind booking links, documented timezone handling for candidates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, candidates self-schedule from live calendar availability — booking links tied to my team's calendars end the timezone email chains

citations.quote: Send the candidate a booking link so they pick a time
